_meta.what: English-language coverage comparison: per-language percentile of each channel's own-language coverage history vs the English percentile, weekly means; divergence is English minus mean non-English. Registered in languages.json. Quantifies language-scope differences for completed series; it does not establish which corpus is correct, represent all Indian-language news, validate the index, or change any score.

coverage.interpretation: Only completed channel-language series appear. Missing series are pending, not zero, and published channels are not an index-wide result until coverage is complete.
